Item 1. Business We manufacture HVAC equipment for commercial buildings and sell through distributors.
The HVAC segment also supplies data-center cooling systems to hyperscale customers in North America.
Item 1A. Risk Factors Commodity prices and labor shortages could hurt results.

Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
Revenue grew 12 percent on volume in the HVAC segment as data center demand increased.
Gross margin expanded 80 basis points and backlog rose to a record level. Management expects
the data-center pipeline to remain the primary growth driver through the next two fiscal years.
Cash from operations funded capital expenditures in the cooling product lines.
Item 3. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk Interest rate risk is modest.
